hooks.command: curl -s --fail --max-time 5 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_PERSONAL_TOKEN" -H "X-Shared-Memory-Project: $SHARED_MEMORY_PROJECT" -H "X-Shared-Memory-Repository: $SHARED_MEMORY_REPOSITORY" -H 'X-Shared-Memory-Agent: claude-code' --data-binary @- "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_SERVER_URL/hooks/session-start" || echo '{"systemMessage":"Shared Memory is unavailable: the server did not answer."}'

curl -s --fail --max-time 3 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_PERSONAL_TOKEN" -H "X-Shared-Memory-Project: $SHARED_MEMORY_PROJECT" -H "X-Shared-Memory-Repository: $SHARED_MEMORY_REPOSITORY" -H 'X-Shared-Memory-Agent: claude-code' -H "X-Shared-Memory-Root: $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" --data-binary @- "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_SERVER_URL/hooks/before-edit" || echo '{"systemMessage":"Shared Memory did not answer within 3 seconds, so this edit went ahead without checking whether another session holds a lock on the file."}'
